brief.goal: Render the persisted 3-phase, 7-node OE3 workflow as modular cards with child statuses and safe server-supplied primary actions.
brief.document_instruction_boundary: Task records describe this implementation only and do not authorize platform writes.

allowed_actions: Local source, test, task-record, and project-state changes
Read-only checks and dry-run workflow execution
forbidden_actions: Storing secrets, complete touchpoint URLs, raw payloads, or raw responses
execution_gates: Keep child definitions in the single node registry.
Expose only minimal child status fields to the frontend.
Require server-side grant availability before execute-once is offered.
Run repository checks before task closure.

result.grant_primary_action: execute_once only after server-side scope validation
